mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) indicate a robust economic expansion that accelerates corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE down and RSAFS up) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1.6 million units annually, it signals a weakening in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a supply shock that disrupts the economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO down and RSAFS up) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (as measured by GDPC1 growth above 2.5% year-over-year), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.5% and RSAFS declines.
